# Respuestas DNS simuladas para las pruebas (formato: nombre TIPO dato).
# Los dominios .test están reservados (RFC 2606): no existen en internet.

# --- bueno.test: todo bien configurado (Google Workspace) ---
bueno.test SOA ns1.bueno.test. hostmaster.bueno.test. 1 7200 3600 1209600 300
bueno.test MX 1 smtp.google.com.
bueno.test TXT v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com -all
bueno.test TXT google-site-verification=abc123
_spf.google.com TXT v=spf1 ip4:74.125.0.0/16 ip4:209.85.128.0/17 ~all
_dmarc.bueno.test TXT v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:dmarc@bueno.test; adkim=s
google._domainkey.bueno.test TXT v=DKIM1; k=rsa; 
_mta-sts.bueno.test TXT v=STSv1; id=20260101
mta-sts.bueno.test A 192.0.2.10
mta-sts.bueno.test HTTPS version: STSv1|mode: enforce|mx: smtp.google.com|max_age: 604800
_smtp._tls.bueno.test TXT v=TLSRPTv1; rua=mailto:tls@bueno.test
bueno.test DS 12345 13 2 ABCDEF

# --- malo.test: Microsoft 365 sin SPF ni DMARC ni DKIM ---
malo.test SOA ns1.malo.test. h.malo.test. 1 7200 3600 1209600 300
malo.test MX 0 malo-test.mail.protection.outlook.com.
malo.test TXT MS=ms12345678

# --- debil.test: +all, DMARC p=none sin informes, pct, sp=none, DKIM 1024 ---
debil.test SOA ns1.debil.test. h.debil.test. 1 7200 3600 1209600 300
debil.test MX 10 mail.debil.test.
debil.test TXT v=spf1 a mx ptr +all
_dmarc.debil.test TXT v=DMARC1; p=none; pct=50
default._domainkey.debil.test TXT v=DKIM1; k=rsa; t=y; p=MIGfMA0GCSqGSIb3DQEBAQUAA4GNADCBiQKBgQCtYue3rcm1hyGm3+952H2gdOj580aMJ6u5mLaSFgn+/fLwCkqwK52+/Ked2rJNp1rYvG/o9c8MUrYrg2JAHW8DTY2VwaynJ+3CR2c+kcbg8RWUbGArJ1CKKgE3Ngr7OoqSDKcDSYtwi2ueBkrjFi4+8nYd1abY/rs+xMiyBW5RqwIDAQAB

# --- debil2.test: quarantine con sp=none ---
debil2.test SOA ns1.debil2.test. h.debil2.test. 1 7200 3600 1209600 300
debil2.test MX 10 mail.debil2.test.
debil2.test TXT v=spf1 mx ~all
_dmarc.debil2.test TXT v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; sp=none; rua=mailto:d@debil2.test

# --- lookups.test: SPF que necesita más de 10 consultas DNS ---
lookups.test SOA ns1.lookups.test. h.lookups.test. 1 7200 3600 1209600 300
lookups.test MX 10 mail.lookups.test.
lookups.test TXT v=spf1 include:a1.test include:a2.test include:a3.test include:a4.test mx -all
a1.test TXT v=spf1 include:b1.test include:b2.test a mx -all
a2.test TXT v=spf1 include:b3.test a -all
a3.test TXT v=spf1 a mx exists:%{i}.x.test -all
a4.test TXT v=spf1 ip4:192.0.2.0/24 -all
b1.test TXT v=spf1 a -all
b2.test TXT v=spf1 mx -all
b3.test TXT v=spf1 a mx -all
_dmarc.lookups.test TXT v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:x@lookups.test

# --- roto.test: dos SPF, dos DMARC, include a un dominio inexistente ---
roto.test SOA ns1.roto.test. h.roto.test. 1 7200 3600 1209600 300
roto.test MX 10 mail.roto.test.
roto.test TXT v=spf1 -all
roto.test TXT v=spf1 include:noexiste.test ~all
_dmarc.roto.test TXT v=DMARC1; p=reject
_dmarc.roto.test TXT v=DMARC1; p=none

# --- incluye.test: include a dominio sin SPF y mecanismo desconocido ---
incluye.test SOA ns1.incluye.test. h.incluye.test. 1 7200 3600 1209600 300
incluye.test MX 10 mail.incluye.test.
incluye.test TXT v=spf1 include:noexiste.test include:sinspf.test foo:bar ip4:999.x -all
sinspf.test TXT hola
_dmarc.incluye.test TXT v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:x@incluye.test

# --- parqueado.test: dominio sin correo ni protección ---
parqueado.test SOA ns1.parqueado.test. h.parqueado.test. 1 7200 3600 1209600 300
parqueado.test A 192.0.2.80

# --- blindado.test: dominio sin correo bien blindado ---
blindado.test SOA ns1.blindado.test. h.blindado.test. 1 7200 3600 1209600 300
blindado.test MX 0 .
blindado.test TXT v=spf1 -all
_dmarc.blindado.test TXT v=DMARC1; p=reject;

# --- falla.test: el DNS falla para DMARC (no debe decir "no tienes DMARC") ---
falla.test SOA ns1.falla.test. h.falla.test. 1 7200 3600 1209600 300
falla.test MX 10 mail.falla.test.
falla.test TXT v=spf1 mx -all
_dmarc.falla.test STATUS SERVFAIL

# --- empresa.test y ventas.empresa.test: DMARC heredado del dominio principal ---
empresa.test SOA ns1.empresa.test. h.empresa.test. 1 7200 3600 1209600 300
_dmarc.empresa.test TXT v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:d@empresa.test
ventas.empresa.test SOA ns1.empresa.test. h.empresa.test. 1 7200 3600 1209600 300
ventas.empresa.test MX 10 mx.ventas.empresa.test.
ventas.empresa.test TXT v=spf1 ip4:192.0.2.5 -all
s1._domainkey.ventas.empresa.test TXT k=ed25519; p=11qYAYKxCrfVS/7TyWQHOg7hcvPapiMlrwIaaPcHURo=

# --- mtsrota.test: registro MTA-STS sin política publicada ---
mtsrota.test SOA ns1.mtsrota.test. h.mtsrota.test. 1 7200 3600 1209600 300
mtsrota.test MX 10 mail.mtsrota.test.
mtsrota.test TXT v=spf1 mx -all
_dmarc.mtsrota.test TXT v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:x@mtsrota.test
_mta-sts.mtsrota.test TXT v=STSv1; id=1

# --- inyeccion.test: registros con secuencias de escape y comillas ---
inyeccion.test SOA ns1.inyeccion.test. h.inyeccion.test. 1 7200 3600 1209600 300
inyeccion.test MX 10 mail.inyeccion.test.
inyeccion.test TXT v=spf1 include:"$(reboot)" ip4:192.0.2.1 -all
_dmarc.inyeccion.test TXT v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:"a\b"@x.test

# --- Casos de la revisión independiente (v1.0.0) ---
down.test SOA a b 1 2 3 4 5
down.test STATUS SERVFAIL
# parked domain with DNS failing on DMARC
parq.test SOA a b 1 2 3 4 5
parq.test MX 0 .
parq.test TXT v=spf1 -all
_dmarc.parq.test STATUS SERVFAIL
# subdomain inherits p=reject; sp=none from parent
org.test SOA a b 1 2 3 4 5
_dmarc.org.test TXT v=DMARC1; p=reject; sp=none; rua=mailto:d@org.test
pagos.org.test SOA a b 1 2 3 4 5
pagos.org.test MX 10 mx.org.test.
pagos.org.test TXT v=spf1 ip4:192.0.2.1 -all
google._domainkey.pagos.org.test TXT v=DKIM1; k=ed25519; p=11qYAYKxCrfVS/7TyWQHOg7hcvPapiMlrwIaaPcHURo=
# duplicated include subtree
dup.test SOA a b 1 2 3 4 5
dup.test MX 10 mx.dup.test.
dup.test TXT v=spf1 include:big.test include:mid.test -all
mid.test TXT v=spf1 include:big.test -all
big.test TXT v=spf1 a mx a:x1.test a:x2.test a:x3.test a:x4.test -all
_dmarc.dup.test TXT v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:d@dup.test
google._domainkey.dup.test TXT v=DKIM1; k=ed25519; p=11qYAYKxCrfVS/7TyWQHOg7hcvPapiMlrwIaaPcHURo=
# DKIM selector servfail
dk.test SOA a b 1 2 3 4 5
dk.test MX 1 smtp.google.com.
dk.test TXT v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all
_dmarc.dk.test TXT v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:d@dk.test
google._domainkey.dk.test STATUS SERVFAIL
# quarantine pct=0
pct.test SOA a b 1 2 3 4 5
pct.test MX 10 mx.pct.test.
pct.test TXT v=spf1 mx -all
_dmarc.pct.test TXT v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; pct=0; rua=mailto:d@pct.test
default._domainkey.pct.test TXT v=DKIM1; k=ed25519; p=11qYAYKxCrfVS/7TyWQHOg7hcvPapiMlrwIaaPcHURo=
# missing p with rua
nop.test SOA a b 1 2 3 4 5
nop.test MX 10 mx.nop.test.
nop.test TXT v=spf1 mx -all
_dmarc.nop.test TXT v=DMARC1; rua=mailto:d@nop.test

# --- Servidores de correo (para la comprobación de MX) ---
mail.debil.test A 192.0.2.25
mail.debil2.test A 192.0.2.25
mail.falla.test A 192.0.2.25
mail.incluye.test A 192.0.2.25
mail.inyeccion.test A 192.0.2.25
mail.lookups.test A 192.0.2.25
mail.mtsrota.test A 192.0.2.25
mail.roto.test A 192.0.2.25
malo-test.mail.protection.outlook.com A 192.0.2.25
mx.dup.test A 192.0.2.25
mx.nop.test A 192.0.2.25
mx.org.test A 192.0.2.25
mx.pct.test A 192.0.2.25
mx.ventas.empresa.test A 192.0.2.25
smtp.google.com A 192.0.2.25

# --- Auditoría v1.1: rangos SPF enormes, MX inexistente, informes DMARC ---
ruaext.test SOA ns1.ruaext.test. h.ruaext.test. 1 7200 3600 1209600 300
ruaext.test MX 1 smtp.google.com.
ruaext.test TXT v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com -all
_dmarc.ruaext.test TXT v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:reports@dmarc-vendor.test,dmarc@ruaext.test
dmarc-vendor.test SOA x
ruamal.test SOA x
ruamal.test MX 1 smtp.google.com.
ruamal.test TXT v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com -all
_dmarc.ruamal.test TXT v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=dmarc@ruamal.test
ancho.test SOA x
ancho.test MX 1 smtp.google.com.
ancho.test TXT v=spf1 ip4:0.0.0.0/1 ip4:128.0.0.0/1 include:spf.hosting-barato.test -all
spf.hosting-barato.test TXT v=spf1 +all
_dmarc.ancho.test TXT v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:d@ancho.test
mxmuerto.test SOA x
mxmuerto.test MX 10 mail.proveedor-viejo-cerrado.test.
mxmuerto.test TXT v=spf1 mx -all
_dmarc.mxmuerto.test TXT v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:d@mxmuerto.test
_mta-sts.mxmuerto.test TXT v=STSv1; id=1
mta-sts.mxmuerto.test A 192.0.2.1
mta-sts.mxmuerto.test HTTPS version: STSv1|mode: enforce|mx: aspmx.l.google.com|max_age: 604800
